title: Telecalling Executive - Real Estate
description:
PropUp Realty is looking for a Telecalling Executive to convert property enquiries into site visits.

What you will do:
- Call leads generated through Google Ads and portal enquiries.
- Understand customer requirements and budget and explain available properties.
- Book site visits against a daily target.
- Send confirmation emails covering visit date, time and site details.
- Follow up with undecided leads until the visit is confirmed.

Requirements:
- Required: 1-3 years of experience in outbound calling or appointment booking.
- Must have fluency in Bengali and Hindi; English is required for email communication.
- Experience with lead handling and target achievement.
- Knowledge of MS Excel for daily reporting.

Nice to have: real estate background.
